lead: The most relaxing mineral, in its gentlest form. 275 mg of magnesium as fully-chelated glycinate — easy on the stomach, easy to absorb — to calm your nervous system, support deeper sleep, and look after your bones, joints and muscles.

science.title: Why glycinate is the gentle one
science.text: Magnesium powers over 300 processes in your body — from nerve calming to muscle relaxation to bone health — yet most people don't get enough. Cheap forms like oxide are poorly absorbed and can upset your stomach. We use magnesium glycinate: magnesium bound to the calming amino acid glycine, so it absorbs well, sits easy on the gut, and brings an extra calming, sleep-friendly edge.

format.title: Magnesium that's kind to your gut
format.text: No laxative effect, no chalky aftertaste. Fully-chelated magnesium glycinate that your body actually absorbs — three small capsules before bed.

absorb.title: Calm the body, settle the mind
absorb.lead: Magnesium helps switch your nervous system from 'go' to 'rest', relaxes muscles, and supports the bones and joints it's stored in.

points.title: Calms the nervous system
points.text: Magnesium supports the 'rest and digest' side of your nervous system — helping you wind down and ease everyday tension.

points.title: Better sleep
points.text: Paired with glycine, it helps quiet the mind and supports deeper, more restful sleep — naturally, no grogginess.

points.title: Bones, joints & muscles
points.text: Most of your body's magnesium lives in your bones; it also supports muscle relaxation and healthy joint function.

facts.warning: If you are pregnant or nursing, under 18, have kidney issues, or take medication, consult a physician before use. Very high magnesium intake may have a laxative effect.

items.q: Why magnesium glycinate over other forms?
items.a: Glycinate is magnesium chelated to the amino acid glycine, so it's absorbed well and gentle on the stomach — unlike cheaper forms (like oxide or citrate) that can cause a laxative effect. The glycine also adds a calming touch.
Many people find magnesium glycinate helps them wind down and sleep more deeply, without the grogginess of a sleeping pill. Take it about an hour before bed.
Evening is ideal to make the most of the calming effect, but any consistent daily time works for the bone and muscle benefits.
